$Comment: The Headless Horseman in the saddle, the form his fight opens with: a Variant of Template_Flying_Aggressive (the game's flying hunters, such as the Incandescent skull) on his skeletal horse (his Appearance, the model Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted, makes the horse walk and gallop while he flies). He does not just hug one player: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride (CombatAdditionalBehaviorComponent, under Components/) dives him at his target and keeps him low for a few seconds, 1 to 3 blocks up (MotionDesiredAltitudeCombat) so swords can reach him, then sends him wide and high around the graveyard, laps its fountain, swoops through a ringed spot and passes over the plaza dropping a ringed row of bombs; tune the timings and the flight points in that file. MotionFlyMaxHeightAboveGround must clear the highest of those points (laps 7 up, swings 7 to 9, the climb point he makes for when something blocks him 10) or he cannot reach them. He throws nothing straight at a player: RangedAttack is empty, which switches off the template's whole ranged attack (its Enabled reads !isEmpty(RangedAttack)), and RangedAttackDistance is still read by the template's chase. Every 4 to 6 seconds (TargetSwitchTimer) he turns on the nearest player unless his target is within TargetRange. The fight's script swaps him to Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman on foot when he is worn down, and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal that role's. Fire hurts him at half (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Fire_Ward in _CombatConfig), never shoved (KnockbackScale 0), DropList Empty since his reward is the Claims his fight pays. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
